scope: one direct financial JEPA paper plus four approved adjacent finance representation and forecasting papers

records.title: Fin-JEPA: Joint-Embedding Predictive Representation Learning for Financial Time Series
source_limitations: prediction error did not reliably discriminate forward returns
SIGReg ablation, PELT regime detection, multi-horizon training, and several baselines were not run

records.title: Trading through Earnings Seasons using Self-Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning
source_limitations: earnings usefulness decays rapidly after release
the source uses contrastive predictive coding rather than JEPA

records.title: Fx-spot predictions with state-of-the-art transformer and time embeddings
source_limitations: the approved projection is limited to three FX pairs at a ten-minute horizon

records.title: EXFormer: A Multi-Scale Trend-Aware Transformer with Dynamic Variable Selection for Foreign Exchange Returns Prediction
source_limitations: the approved projection covers day-ahead FX returns and does not establish other horizons or asset classes

records.title: Denoised Labels for Financial Time-Series Data via Self-Supervised Learning
source_limitations: the approved projection covers daily S&P 500, one-minute Bitcoin, and one limit-order dataset

interpretation_boundary: Only N11-FIN-01 is a direct JEPA paper. N11-FIN-02 through N11-FIN-05 are approved adjacent evidence and are not relabeled as JEPA.
